notes: G3 spec (until-end-of-turn->permanent on the 3/3). Printed: 'Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may have this enchantment become a 3/3 Sphinx creature with flying in addition to its other types UNTIL END OF TURN.' You cast Crash Through and take the may: Riddleform is a 3/3 flier for the turn. After the turn ends it is a plain enchantment again: no creature, no 3/3, no flying. A noncreature permanent has no power or toughness (CR 208.3): both read null.
